title: Elite Dangerous Cockpit Light Dimmer — Elite Nexus
description: Dim Elite Dangerous cockpit lights independently of the HUD. Adjust light kept and reach, use F9/F10/F11 in flight, and manage the optional graphics hook from Elite Nexus.
heading: Less cabin light. More of the galaxy.
lead: Turn down the cockpit’s own lamps and glow with a dedicated dimmer. Keep your HUD readable, your surroundings unchanged, and adjust the cabin while you fly.
hero_alt: Elite Nexus Cockpit lights tab with the installed dimmer, Light kept and Reach settings, and F9, F10 and F11 keyboard controls.
hero_caption: A dedicated dimmer for the cockpit’s own lights, with saved settings and in-game keyboard controls.

related.label: HUD colours
related.description: Make your own theme and preserve the contact colours you fly by.

related.label: Glare & exposure
related.description: Find a more comfortable balance of bright lights and dark tones.

related.description: Plan the journey beyond the canopy and keep valuable discoveries in view.
